# Queuebird

A job queue for Node.js. Every job is written to Redis before acknowledgment, so a crash never loses queued work.

Two engineers at the agency Studio Kelapa started Queuebird in 2025 after their email jobs kept vanishing during server restarts. In production at Studio Kelapa it processes about 1.8 million jobs per day with a median latency of 42 milliseconds.

## Requirements

Node.js 18 or newer, Redis 7.0 or newer.

## Install

```
npm install queuebird
```

Set the connection with the `QUEUEBIRD_REDIS_URL` environment variable.

## Retries

Failed jobs are retried up to 5 times with exponential backoff, starting at 2 seconds.

## Contributing

One firm rule: "never merge a change that lowers test coverage below 90 percent."

As of September 2026 the project has 3,400 stars on GitHub.

In modern web development, handling background tasks efficiently is absolutely crucial for delivering a smooth user experience. Queuebird was started in 2025 by two engineers at the agency Studio Kelapa after their email jobs kept vanishing during server restarts. To solve that, every job is written to Redis before acknowledgment, so a crash never loses queued work. The library requires Node.js 18 or newer and Redis 7.0 or newer. A: This study aims to delve into the effectiveness of gamification in improving student engagement in online programming courses. In recent years, massive open online courses have gained significant popularity, yet completion rates remain notoriously low. The research was conducted at Nusantara Open Academy over a 12-week term beginning in February 2026, involving 486 learners. Participants were divided into a control group and an experimental group that received badges, streaks, and a weekly leaderboard. The experimental group achieved a course completion rate of 63 percent, compared with 29 percent in the control group. Analysis of activity logs suggests the gain came mainly from streak reminders, which cut the average gap between study sessions from 5.1 days to 2.3 days. Interestingly, the leaderboard showed no measurable effect on quiz scores. These findings carry important implications for instructional designers seeking to foster sustained participation. In conclusion, gamification, when thoughtfully implemented, represents a powerful and pivotal tool for enhancing online learning outcomes. A: Small-scale fisheries play a crucial role in sustaining coastal economies across Indonesia. However, fishers in many villages continue to face significant challenges in accessing fair market prices. In Tanjung Bira Selatan, a fishing village of 260 households, catches are sold almost exclusively to three middlemen who set prices each morning. Interviews conducted between 5 and 19 January 2026 revealed that fishers receive on average 42 percent of the final retail price of red snapper. This imbalance arises largely because fishers lack real-time information about prices at the Paotere Baru fish auction, 180 kilometers away. As a result, household incomes fell by roughly Rp 600,000 per month during the 2025 lean season. The village cooperative, Nelayan Bersatu, has stated that any solution "must be usable by fishers who only own basic feature phones." Given this context, it is essential to delve into how a simple price-broadcast service could shift bargaining power. This study therefore designs and evaluates an SMS-based price information system tailored to local needs. In summary, the research seeks to offer a practical, scalable, and inclusive intervention for coastal communities.

# LedgerLite

A double-entry bookkeeping library for small businesses. Every transaction must balance to zero before it can be saved, which stops the silent drift in balances that many early adopters lived with in their spreadsheets.

Built by the Open Finance Collective in Yogyakarta. First stable release: version 1.0.0, 30 June 2026.

## Requirements

Python 3.11 and above. No external dependencies apart from SQLite.

## Install

```
pip install ledgerlite
```

Then run the example in `examples/quickstart.py`.

## Storing amounts

"all amounts must be stored as integers in the smallest currency unit" to avoid floating-point errors.

## Performance

On a standard laptop, LedgerLite posts 50,000 journal entries in under 9 seconds.

## Contributing

27 contributors have worked on the codebase so far. See CONTRIBUTING.md.

## License

Apache 2.0

A: Ketahanan pangan merupakan isu yang semakin krusial di tengah perubahan iklim global yang kian tidak menentu. Penelitian ini mengembangkan model prediksi curah hujan bulanan untuk mendukung penentuan jadwal tanam di Kabupaten Wajo Raya. Data yang digunakan berupa catatan curah hujan dari 9 stasiun pengamatan selama periode 2010 hingga 2025. Metode yang diterapkan adalah Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) yang dibandingkan dengan model ARIMA sebagai pembanding. Hasil eksperimen memperlihatkan bahwa LSTM menghasilkan nilai RMSE sebesar 31,7 mm, lebih rendah dibandingkan ARIMA yang mencapai 48,2 mm. Lebih jauh lagi, uji coba bersama Kelompok Tani Sipakainge menunjukkan bahwa penyesuaian jadwal tanam berdasarkan prediksi mampu mengurangi gagal semai hingga 17 persen. Temuan tersebut membuka peluang yang sangat menjanjikan bagi pengembangan sistem pendukung keputusan pertanian yang lebih adaptif. Dengan demikian, penelitian ini memberikan kontribusi yang berarti bagi pengembangan pertanian presisi di Indonesia.
